reviewScope.sourceEvidence: current production strip description plus prior PriZim extraction/bleed report

duplicateLimbs.notes: No extra arm or leg is indicated across the six-frame production strip.

limbCountAndAttachment.notes: Attack poses remain anatomically coherent through ready, coil, drive, impact, recoil and recover.

handsAndFingerTopology.notes: Hands are mostly enclosed by oversized gauntlets. PZ must verify there is only one fist/thumb mass per gauntlet and no duplicated wrist/forearm geometry where green FX overlaps.

eyesAndPupilDirection.notes: Face and gaze are consistently described as focused/right-facing; no crossed-eye read is indicated.

faceIdentityContinuity.notes: Youthful face, hair, age and expression remain consistent across the strip.

anatomyObjectFusion.notes: Peak green energy overlaps the striking gauntlet. Preserve a readable fist/gauntlet silhouette so FX cannot be mistaken for an extra limb or second fist.

costumeObjectContinuity.notes: Armor, cape, chest gem, boots and gauntlets remain one coherent design across the attack.

frameToFrameIdentityDrift.notes: No major anatomy, age or character-model drift is indicated in the production strip.

pzDecision: No gross anatomy artifact is indicated, but because the current repo binary was not available for direct pixel-level inspection in this pass, Kineza remains conditional until one final high-resolution gauntlet/eye audit is completed.
